rv.q: It's entertaining: funny, and Oisín Kearney directs with energetic verve.
...a startling and brilliant new play that really pulls us into the mud of assault...
It is tense, uncomfortable and moving.

About a year ago, Faye came back home from a party to discover an intruder in her house. He attacked her, knocked her out, and when she came around he was standing over her with his dick out. Traumatised but unable to get any medical help she is becoming increasingly desperate.
